subtitle_or_header:
Transform Sequence Elements in Parallel
[Calculation of Self Attention of words ( X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄)]

bullets: [Calculation of Self Attention of words ( X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄)]
labels: Similarity (cream pill, blue text; repeated once per panel, 4x total)
Weighted SUM (cream pill, blue text; 4x total)
Dot Product (two-line label 'Dot' / 'Product' on tan box)
K,q (annotation with tiny arrow pointing into the Dot Product box)
K,q / √d (fraction annotation above the Scaling box)
Scaling by √d (vertical text inside pink box)
Soft max (vertical text inside pink box)
W^q (small red-bordered box at bottom of front panel)
q₁ [?] (output label of the bottom W^q box)
W^k [?] (blue box label, 4x per panel; tiny blurry superscript, could read W^q)
X (green cell letter inside every green dashed input box; 12 cells per panel × 4 panels = 48 instances)
Y (green cell letter inside every green dashed output box; 4 cells per box × 4 output boxes = 16 instances)
equations: Σ (summation symbol in the pale-blue weighted-sum box)

layout.arrangement: Full-bleed light-gray slide enclosed by a thin dark-red rectangular frame with a thicker dark-red strip along the bottom edge. Three-line bold title block sits top-left-of-center. Yellow '39' ellipse at top-right. One large cascading diagram dominates the center: four identical peach rounded-rectangle panels overlapping in a diagonal stack from front-bottom-left to back-top-right, each panel containing the same self-attention pipeline. Four thick red up-arrows labeled X₁–X₄ enter from bottom-center; green dashed Y₁–Y₄ output boxes with red up-arrows exit along a rising diagonal at the panels' tops; a rotated yellow '*** Run in Parallel ***' sticker sits bottom-right.

regions.name: Title block
regions.content: Three bold centered lines: 'Parallel Processing' / 'Transform Sequence Elements in Parallel' / '[Calculation of Self Attention of words ( X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄)]' with the X symbols in red

regions.name: Slide number
regions.content: Yellow ellipse, dark-red outline, bold dark-red '39'

regions.name: Panel stack (parallel computations)
regions.content: Four overlapping peach rounded panels, each an identical self-attention pipeline — green dashed 'X' input box (4 cells), 4 W^k→K rows, tan 'Dot Product' box with 8-dot scatter, pink 'Scaling by √d' and 'Soft max' boxes, pale-blue 'Σ' box, 4 red ⊗ nodes with V₁–V₄ / 'W^V' inputs, 'W^q'→'q₁' branch, bottom 4-cell 'X' row, 3 cream pills; front panel fully visible, rear panels progressively clipped (only right-hand 'X' boxes, W^V boxes, top pills and top output areas showing)

regions.name: Output diagonal Y₁–Y₄
regions.position: upper area over the panels; x 47%-78%, y 18%-40%
regions.content: Four green dashed boxes of four 'Y' cells each, red up-arrow to a large red subscripted label Y₁ (lowest/leftmost) through Y₄ (highest/rightmost)

regions.name: Input arrows
regions.content: Four thick red vertical up-arrows labeled below in bold red: X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄

regions.name: Parallel-distribution connectors
regions.position: bottom-left of the panel stack, curving right along the bottom and sweeping up the right side (to ≈ x 95%)
regions.content: Dashed light-green (#A5D6A7) curved connectors with small green arrowheads: one from the front panel's bottom highlighted input row curving up its left side into the left 'X' box; one long curve distributing the input sequence to the rear panels' right-hand 'X' boxes

regions.name: Sticker
regions.content: Yellow rectangle rotated ≈ -8° with bold red text '*** Run in Parallel ***'

regions.name: Frame
regions.content: Thin dark-red rectangular frame inset ~4% from slide edges; thicker dark-red band across the very bottom

layout.hierarchy: The peach panel stack dominates (~75% of canvas). Second in salience are the saturated red elements (X/Y labels, arrows, sticker text, ⊗ nodes). Title is bold but visually secondary to the diagram; the smallest text (≈7-9pt) is the pipeline labels inside panels. Yellow sticker and '39' ellipse are small but very high-contrast accents.

visual_elements.description: Front-panel self-attention pipeline (identical on all 4 panels). Left to right: (a) green dashed rounded box with 4 stacked pale-pink cells each holding a green letter 'X'; (b) four rows, each = small white box with blue border labeled 'W^k [?]' → 3 tiny pale-yellow cells (vector components; source count 2-3) → label 'K₁ [?]'…'K₄ [?]'; (c) tan vertical rectangle 'Dot Product' containing 8 blue dots of varying size (approximate count) linked by thin lines; label 'K,q' with a tiny arrow points into it; (d) fraction annotation 'K,q / √d'; (e) pink vertical rounded box with rotated text 'Scaling by √d'; (f) pink vertical rounded box with rotated text 'Soft max'; (g) pale-blue horizontal box 'Σ' at top right; (h) four red ⊗ (circle-cross) nodes in a vertical column below Σ, each fed from the right by labels 'V₁'…'V₄' and blue 'W^V' boxes that take input from a second green dashed box of four 'X' cells at the panel's right edge; thin red probability lines fan from 'Soft max' to each ⊗; each ⊗ feeds up into 'Σ'; (i) below the Dot Product box: small red-bordered box 'W^q' producing a cell labeled 'q₁ [?]' with a thin line up into the Dot Product box; (j) bottom of panel: horizontal green dashed box of 4 'X' cells with the first cell highlighted (pink fill, red border); dashed green arrow from this row up the left edge into the input 'X' box. Along the panel's top edge sit three cream pills with blue text: 'Similarity' (above Dot Product), 'Probabilities' (above Soft max), 'Weighted SUM' (above Σ).
visual_elements.position: center; front panel approx x 13%-71%, y 43%-91%

visual_elements.description: Four identical peach rounded-rectangle panels in a cascading stack; each panel behind is offset ≈ +7% right and ≈ -5% up relative to the one in front, representing the same computation run for X₁ (front) through X₄ (back). Rear panels are clipped by the panels in front; visible parts are their right-hand green 'X' boxes, W^V boxes, top pills ('Similarity', 'Probabilities', 'Weighted SUM') and top output areas.
visual_elements.position: center, diagonally staggered from x 12% to x 95%

visual_elements.description: Four output groups along a rising diagonal at the panels' tops: each is a green dashed rounded box containing 4 pale cells with green 'Y' letters, with a thick red block up-arrow to a large red subscripted label. Order from lowest/leftmost to highest/rightmost: Y₁ (≈x 47-55%, y 33-40%), Y₂ (≈x 55-62%, y 28-34%), Y₃ (≈x 62-70%, y 22-29%), Y₄ (≈x 70-78%, y 18-25%).
Four thick red vertical block up-arrows along the bottom (x ≈ 31%, 40%, 50%, 59%), each labeled beneath in bold red with subscript: X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄; they feed the input row / panels from below.

Dot-product scatter inside the tan 'Dot Product' box: 8 blue dots of varying diameters (approximate count) connected by thin gray lines (small mesh/network look), receiving lines from the K-vector cells and from q₁ below.
visual_elements.position: center-left of front panel, x ≈ 27%-33%, y ≈ 49%-75%

visual_elements.description: Dashed light-green connector curves: one from the bottom highlighted input row curving up the left side into the front panel's green 'X' box; a long dashed curve sweeping right and up with small green arrowheads entering the rear panels' right-hand 'X' boxes — indicating the same input sequence is distributed to all four parallel computations.
visual_elements.position: bottom-left curving across bottom and up the right side

visual_elements.description: Yellow sticker/banner rotated ≈ -8° (tilted up to the right) with bold red text '*** Run in Parallel ***'.
visual_elements.position: bottom-right, x 72%-92%, y 81%-92%, overlapping the panels' lower-right corner

visual_elements.description: Slide number badge: yellow ellipse with dark-red outline containing bold dark-red '39'.

imagery: No photographs, clip-art or illustrations; all visuals are flat vector-style schematic shapes (rounded panels, dashed boxes, small cells, block arrows, pills, dots, ⊗ symbols) in a hand-diagram lecture style.

colors.background: #EBEBEB (light gray; margin outside the frame slightly darker gray, hex not sampled)
colors.body_text: #333333 (diagram labels; blue #1F3FBF for W-box and pill text; dark red #A02040 for vertical pink-box text; dark red #8B0000 for the slide-number badge)
accents: #CC0000 (red arrows, X/Y labels, ⊗ nodes, sticker text)
#00A651 (green dashed boxes and X/Y cell letters)
#FFFDE7 (cream pills; approximate hex carried from original brief)

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). Title lines are bold with decreasing size (~20pt → 17pt → 15pt), center-aligned as a block; in line 3 the four X symbols are red with subscript digits. Diagram text is very small (≈7-9pt). 'Scaling by √d' and 'Soft max' are rotated 90° (reading bottom-to-top) inside vertical pink boxes; 'Dot Product' is stacked on two lines. Heavy use of subscripts (X₁…X₄, Y₁…Y₄, K₁…K₄, V₁…V₄, q₁). Pill labels ('Similarity', 'Probabilities', 'Weighted SUM') in blue; 'SUM' in capitals. '*** Run in Parallel ***' is bold red on yellow, rotated ≈ -8°. Slide number bold dark red.
animation_state: No mid-build state: all four panels, all outputs Y₁–Y₄, all pills and all labels are fully visible simultaneously — a static figure deliberately showing everything at once (parallelism).
recreation_brief:
1. Create a 16:9 slide; fill the background light gray #EBEBEB.
2. Draw the frame: a #9E3D3D rectangle outline (~2pt) inset ~4% from all four edges, plus a solid #9E3D3D band ~3% of slide height across the full bottom edge.
3. Place title line 1 'Parallel Processing' — Arial Bold 20pt, black #000000, centered at x≈33% (block spans x 7%-58%), top edge at y≈8%.
4. Place title line 2 'Transform Sequence Elements in Parallel' — Arial Bold 17pt, black, centered directly below line 1.
5. Place title line 3 '[Calculation of Self Attention of words ( X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄)]' — Arial Bold 15pt, black, with the four X's in red #CC0000 and subscripted digits.
6. Place the slide-number badge: yellow #FFFF00 ellipse ~0.55"×0.35" at x 90%-95%, y 11%-16%, with a #8B0000 1.5pt outline and bold '39' in #8B0000 14pt.
7. Place the FRONT PANEL: rounded rectangle spanning x 13%-71%, y 43%-91% (≈7.7"×3.6" on a 13.33"×7.5" canvas), fill peach #FCE4C8, outline tan #E0B080 1pt.
8. Inside the panel's left edge place the input box: green dashed rounded box (#00A651, dashed 1.5pt) ~0.5"×1.2" holding 4 stacked cells (fill #F9D5E5, thin gray outline), each with bold green 'X' 8pt.
9. To the right of the input box place 4 identical K-rows stacked vertically: each row = white box 0.35"×0.22" with #1F3FBF 1pt outline and blue 7pt text 'W^k' (superscript k; source blurry, may read W^q — render as W^k), followed by 3 tiny cells filled #FFF6BF, followed by blue 7pt label 'K₁'/'K₂'/'K₃'/'K₄' (source blurry; render as listed).
10. Place the Dot Product box: vertical tan #D2A26A rectangle ~0.55"×1.5" at x≈27%-33%, y≈49%-75%, with dark 8pt text 'Dot' / 'Product' stacked on two lines at its top.
11. Inside the Dot Product box place the scatter: 8 blue #1F3FBF dots (3-5pt, varying diameters) connected by thin gray #888888 lines (mesh/network look).
12. Place the annotation 'K,q' (7pt) with a tiny arrow pointing into the Dot Product box.
13. Place the fraction annotation 'K,q' over '√d' (7pt, with fraction bar) above the Scaling box.
14. Place the Scaling box: vertical pink #F7C9D4 rounded box ~0.3"×1.1" with 'Scaling by √d' rotated 90° (reading bottom-to-top), dark red #A02040, 8pt.
15. Place the Soft max box: vertical pink #F7C9D4 rounded box ~0.3"×1.1" with 'Soft max' rotated 90°, dark red #A02040, 8pt.
16. Place the Σ box: pale-blue #C9DFF5 horizontal rectangle ~0.9"×0.25" at the panel's top-right with black 'Σ' 12pt.
17. Below Σ place 4 red #CC0000 ⊗ (circle-cross) symbols ~0.15" in a vertical column; connect each ⊗ up into Σ with a thin line (color unspecified in source; use thin red).
18. To the right of each ⊗ place the pair: label 'V₁'…'V₄' (7pt) and a white box with #1F3FBF 1pt outline and blue 7pt text 'W^V'.
19. At the panel's right edge place a second green dashed rounded box (#00A651, dashed 1.5pt) with 4 cells (fill #F9D5E5) each holding bold green 'X' 8pt; draw lines from these cells into the four W^V boxes.
20. Fan thin red #CC0000 lines from the Soft max box to each of the 4 ⊗ symbols.
21. Below the Dot Product box place the query branch: small white box with red 1pt outline and red 7pt text 'W^q', followed by a tiny #FFF6BF cell labeled 'q₁' 7pt; draw a thin line from the q₁ cell up into the Dot Product box.
22. At the panel bottom place the input row: horizontal green dashed box (#00A651) ~2.2"×0.3" with 4 cells — cell 1 fill #F9D5E5 with red 1.5pt outline and green 'X' (highlighted), cells 2-4 white with green 'X'.
23. Draw a dashed light-green #A5D6A7 curved arrow from the input row's left end curving up the panel's left side into the left 'X' box, ending in a small green arrowhead.
24. Along the panel's top edge place 3 cream #FFFDE7 pills ~0.55"×0.18" with blue #1F3FBF 7pt text: 'Similarity' above the Dot Product box, 'Probabilities' above the Soft max box, 'Weighted SUM' above the Σ box.
25. Group the whole front panel, duplicate it 3 times, and offset each copy ≈+7% of slide width rightward and ≈5% of slide height upward (≈+0.93"/−0.38"); set z-order panel 1 (X₁) frontmost to panel 4 (X₄) rearmost, so rear panels are clipped by those in front.
26. Place 4 output groups along the rising diagonal above the panels: each = green dashed rounded box with 4 cells (fill #F9D5E5) holding bold green 'Y' 8pt (16 Y cells total) + a thick red #CC0000 block up-arrow + bold red 14pt subscripted label — Y₁ at x 47%-55%, y 33%-40% (label ≈50%, 33%); Y₂ at x 55%-62%, y 28%-34% (≈57%, 28%); Y₃ at x 62%-70%, y 22%-29% (≈65%, 23%); Y₄ at x 70%-78%, y 18%-25% (≈73%, 18%).
27. Place 4 thick red #CC0000 block up-arrows ~0.25"×0.5" at x≈31%, 40%, 50%, 59% (y 88%-93%); beneath each place a bold red 14pt subscripted label 'X₁', 'X₂', 'X₃', 'X₄'.
28. Draw the distribution connector: a dashed light-green #A5D6A7 curve sweeping from the bottom input area rightward along the bottom and up the right side, with small green #00A651 arrowheads entering the rear panels' right-hand 'X' boxes.
29. Place the sticker: yellow #FFFF00 rectangle ~2"×0.45" at x 72%-92%, y 81%-92%, rotated −8°, with bold red #CC0000 14pt text '*** Run in Parallel ***'.
30. Verify every text string matches verbatim_text exactly (apply subscripts via PowerPoint subscript formatting) and every fill/outline color matches the hex values in colors.

fixes_applied: verbatim_text.bullets was empty (required non-empty); reconstructed with the slide's 4 free-standing text lines: the 3 title-block lines and '*** Run in Parallel ***' (all derivable from slide_title, subtitle_or_header and labels).
Added missing layout.regions entry 'Parallel-distribution connectors' to cover the dashed light-green connector arrows listed in visual_elements but mapped to no region.

Expanded the 'Panel stack' region content so it explicitly enumerates every pipeline sub-element (X input box, W^k/K rows, Dot Product scatter, Scaling/Soft max boxes, Σ, ⊗ nodes, V/W^V column, W^q/q₁ branch, bottom X row, 3 pills).
Replaced the vague quantifier 'many instances' (label 'X') with the exact count 48 (12 X cells per panel × 4 panels) and quantified label 'Y' as 16 instances (4 cells × 4 output boxes).
Standardized the conflicting blue hex codes #1F3FBF (flowchart, colors.body_text) vs #1F4FBF (graph) to #1F3FBF everywhere.
Reconciled front-panel size: the brief said 5.6"×2.5" but the flowchart position gives x 13%-71%, y 43%-91% (≈7.7"×3.6" on 16:9); standardized the brief to the percentage extents.
Reconciled panel-stack offset: the brief said +0.65"/−0.25" but the highlight-box element gives ≈+7% right / ≈5% up (≈+0.93"/−0.38" on 16:9); standardized the brief to the percentages.
Standardized '2-3 tiny pale-yellow cells' per K-row to 3 cells (matching the original brief); count flagged as uncertain.
Replaced color-name-only specs in the brief with explicit hexes: badge outline/text #8B0000, pink-box vertical text #A02040, dot-connector lines #888888, cream pills #FFFDE7 (approximate).
Changed 'roughly 8 blue dots' to '8 blue dots' (approximate count noted in uncertain_items).
Rewrote recreation_brief as a 30-step ordered checklist; each step places one element (or an exactly counted repeated set) with exact text, position, color and shape.
uncertain_items: W^k [?]: the superscript of the 4 blue W-boxes per panel (16 total) is blurry and could read W^q.
K₁ [?]–K₄ [?]: the K-vector output labels are not clearly legible.
q₁ [?]: the output label of the bottom W^q box is not clearly legible.
Cream pill fill #FFFDE7 is an approximation carried from the original brief, not a sampled palette value.
The dot count in the Dot Product scatter is approximate (source: ~8).
The number of pale-yellow vector cells per K-row is 2-3 in the source; standardized to 3.
The color of the ⊗→Σ connector lines is unspecified in the source; the brief defaults to thin red.
Sticker rotation (≈−8°) and panel offsets (≈+7%/−5%) are approximations.
The 16:9 aspect ratio is assumed from the original brief; source metadata does not state the aspect ratio.
The margin outside the dark-red frame is described only as 'slightly darker gray' with no hex value.
